mapper.select: SELECT ad.id, ad.acceptance_id AS acceptanceId, ad.material_id AS materialId, ad.batch_id AS batchId, ad.acceptance_quantity AS acceptanceQuantity, ad.qualified_quantity AS qualifiedQuantity, ad.unqualified_quantity AS unqualifiedQuantity, ad.unit_price AS unitPrice, ad.total_price AS totalPrice, ad.quality_status AS qualityStatus, ad.remark, ad.create_time AS createTime FROM spd_acceptance_detail ad WHERE ad.acceptance_id = #{acceptanceId} AND ad.del_flag = #{delFlag} ORDER BY ad.id
